title: Retail Edge POC: SOW + Workshop Plan
content:
Executive summary:

This document is a combined statement of work (SOW) and workshop plan for a targeted Proof of Concept (POC) with RetailCo to validate Redwood Inference for in-store conversational agents and on-prem inventory retrieval. The goal is to demonstrate low-latency, private deployment (VPC/on-prem hybrid) of a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflow integrated with RetailCo's POS/inventory APIs.

Primary objectives:
- Deploy a private Redwood runtime in RetailCo's single-region VPC (customer-managed) with secure connectors to inventory and promotions APIs.
- Validate 95th-percentile response latency < 300ms for short queries (<= 64 tokens) with autoscaling to handle burst of 200 qps.
- Demonstrate RAG pipeline: semantic search over a 5M-row product catalog + grounding with a tuned 7B open model (quantized).
- Deliver a 2-day workshop for product and infra teams, plus handoff docs and a posterity eval harness.

Scope (what we will do):
1) Kickoff & discovery (week 0): 2-hour kickoff, inventory of data sources, security review, network access plan.
2) Workshop (onsite or virtual) (week 1): 2-day interactive workshop. Day 1 = architecture, data mapping, prompt design; Day 2 = lab exercises: deploy a small private cluster, run sample RAG flows, collect metrics.
3) Private deployment baseline (weeks 2–3): single AZ VPC deployment (2x A10g-equivalent nodes), model onboarding (quantized 7B), KV/prefix caching enabled, connectors to read-only inventory replica.
4) Performance tuning & testing (week 4): latency tuning (batching config, kernel selection), stress test to 200 qps, trace collection.
5) Acceptance & handoff (week 5): run eval prompts from RetailCo testset, produce report (latency, cost per query, failure modes), deliver runbook and rollback procedures.

Out of scope (explicit):
- Building or hosting a production multi-region deployment.
- Full data migration or ETL beyond the read-only replica and sample indexing.
- Long-term SLA commitments or on-going 24/7 managed operations beyond the 6-week POC support window.

Deliverables:
- Workshop slide deck and lab notebooks
- Deployed private Redwood instance (temporary environment) with access for RetailCo engineers
- RAG demo application with source code in a GitHub repo and deployment scripts
- Performance report (latency percentiles, throughput, cost estimate per 1000 queries)
- Handoff runbook and configuration checklist
- Short list of production recommendations (scaling, pricing, model variant suggestions)

Success criteria (mutually agreed):
- Demonstrable RAG demo in RetailCo environment with live inventory lookup 
- 95th-percentile latency <= 300ms measured across test runs with production-like query mix
- End-to-end throughput of sustained 120 qps with headroom to 200 qps without error rate > 1%
- Evaluation tests (RetailCo's 250 prompt testset): answer accuracy >= 86% (grounding metric)

Staffing & roles (Redwood):
- Solutions engineer (lead, 0.6 FTE during POC): Avery Park (technical lead, deployment, workshop facilitator)
- Applied ML engineer (0.3 FTE): Sana Kapoor (model quantization, eval harness)
- DevOps/infra engineer (0.5 FTE): Miguel Torres (VPC setup, connectors, autoscaling config)
- Customer success (onboarding + admin): Jordan Lee (coordination, billing, logistics)

Estimated timeline:
- Week 0: kickoff
- Week 1: workshop
- Weeks 2–3: deploy baseline and onboard model
- Week 4: performance tuning and stress tests
- Week 5: acceptance & handoff

Pricing & billing (proposal):
Option A — Fixed-fee POC (recommended for clarity):
- Professional services fixed fee: $75,000 (covers all activities and staffing listed above during the 6-week engagement)
- Travel & expenses: billed at cost if onsite workshop required (estimate $4,000)
- Optional add-ons (separate SOW): extended 3-month pilot support ($20,000/mo), production readiness package (estimated $60k one-time)

Option B — Time & materials (if RetailCo prefers consumption):
- SE rate: $250/hr
- Applied ML engineer: $275/hr
- Infra engineer: $225/hr
- Minimum commitment: 200 hours billed at start (applies toward final invoice)

Notes on pricing rationale:
- Fixed-fee simplifies procurement and aligns incentives; assumes standard access to read-only replicas and timely security review.
- If full private hardware procurement is required (on-prem machines), pricing will be revisited after hardware spec confirmation.

Billing terms:
- 50% upfront at SOW signature, 40% at start of week 3 (post-deploy baseline), 10% upon acceptance. Net 30.

Assumptions & dependencies (customer):
- RetailCo provides a read-only replica or API access to inventory and promotions data within 5 business days after kickoff.
- Network access (VPC peering or private link) can be established within 7 business days; necessary firewall rules and IAM permissions granted for Redwood engineers.
- RetailCo designates two technical contacts for workshop and deployment.

Risks & mitigations:
- Data availability delays -> mitigation: schedule parallel workshop exercises using sanitized sample datasets to keep timeline.
- Network restrictions preventing VPC peering -> mitigation: we can run an isolated on-prem demo with synthetic traffic if necessary, but latency targets may not match real environment.
- Model performance gaps on domain language -> mitigation: allocate applied ML time for prompt tuning, small curated training/eval set, and fallback policy to a smaller retrieval window.

Workshop agenda (2 days):
Day 1 (4 hours):
- Intro, goals, success criteria (30m)
- Architecture review: private deployment options + security (45m)
- Data mapping: inventory, SKU schemas, promos (60m)
- Prompt engineering primer and rubric (45m)
- Q&A & action items (30m)

Day 2 (4 hours):
- Hands-on lab: deploy reference stack (60m)
- Model onboarding and quantization walk-through (45m)
- RAG lab: index sample dataset and run queries (60m)
- Metrics and tracing: interpret token-level cost and latency (30m)
- Next steps & ownership (45m)

Acceptance testing checklist (for customer sign-off):
- Demo app runs in customer environment and returns grounded answers for 20/25 sample prompts
- Latency/throughput report provided and verified by RetailCo engineering
- Access to GitHub repo and runbook confirmed
- Security checklist signed off by RetailCo infosec

Optional production handoff (post-POC):
- Dedicated capacity sizing and reserved contract (quote to be provided after POC)
- Production rollouts: canary/A-B plan and automatic fallback policies
- Extended SLAs and compliance add-ons (HIPAA/PCI consult available)

Next steps (action items):
- RetailCo to confirm SOW acceptance and sign. Point of contact: Sarah Nguyen (RetailCo PM).
- Redwood to schedule kickoff meeting and share pre-read (network checklist, sample dataset template).
- Team to confirm workshop format (onsite vs virtual) and dates (two consecutive weekdays preferred).

Contacts:
- Redwood SE lead: Avery Park (avery.park@redwood.com)
- Applied ML: Sana Kapoor (sana.kapoor@redwood.com)
- Customer success: Jordan Lee (jordan.lee@redwood.com)

Document history:
- Drafted 2025-01-14 by Avery Park
- Internal review 2025-01-23 (Sana, Miguel comments merged)
- Updated pricing and timeline 2025-02-03

Open questions for RetailCo:
- Can RetailCo provide a small socialized dataset (anonymized purchase logs) for grounding evaluation?
- Are there IP constraints on storing token-level logs for debugging?
- Will RetailCo accept a temporary test account for secret rotation during the POC?

End of document.
